Is it really free?
Yes. Every game on the site is free to play, and there is nothing to buy. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter, so you can open a game and start playing.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run instantly in your browser, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, many games are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn the phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site allows only family-friendly games: no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Recently played games, favourites and your light or dark choice are kept in your own browser and never leave your device. Most games also save their progress in the browser, but clearing your browser data or using private mode will lose all of it.
What are the cookie settings about?
Visitors in Europe are asked before any non-essential cookies are used. You can change your choice at any time with "Cookie settings" in the footer.
A game will not load. What can I do?
If a game will not load, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it is, so we can look into it. Also check the game's page, since a few older games need a keyboard and mouse.
Where do the games come from?

Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia, made 6 of them. Others are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and 14 were sent in directly by independent developers. Games are never copied from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?
Yes, it is free and non-exclusive at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and accepted games get their own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own site, and how do I reach a human?

The site's own games have an "Embed this game" box on their page with ready-made code. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so they cannot be embedded. For anything else, write to contact@ilovewebgames.com.
